unit_name: LXIV Corps (LXIV Reserve Corps until 5 August 1944)
current_activity: The LXIV Corps (Thumm) takes over the former LXXXIX Corps zone from Domèvre to Saulcy-sur-Meurthe
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 19 p. 338: "General Wiese had to shift the zone of Thumm's LXIV Corps northward to take over the LXXXIX Corps sector. The new LXIV Corps front was about twenty-three miles wide and extended from Domevre" ... "to Saulcy-sur-Meurthe"; p. 339: "These command and control changes had become effective between 30 October and 1 November". Event definition: the change took effect between 30 October and 1 November; 31 October is the middle of the window and an approximate date. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Baccarat, near the middle of the 23-mile front, with a precision of 25 km. Location approximate: a sector point; the corps headquarters is not placed. Location support: CMH names the two ends of the front. Commander: General Thumm. Context: the LXXXIX Corps headquarters (von Gilsa) was transferred to the First Army.

unit_name: LXIV Corps (LXIV Reserve Corps until 5 August 1944)
location_qualifier: front from the Rhine-Marne Canal to Saulcy-sur-Meurthe
current_activity: LXIV Corps (Thumm) holds the right wing of the Nineteenth Army from the canal to Saulcy with five divisions
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 20 p. 362: "General Thumm's LXIV Corps held the army's right wing from the canal southeast some thirty-five miles to Saulcy-sur-Meurthe"; "On 7 November the LXIV Corps had on line, from north to south, the two-regiment 553d Volksgrenadier Division". Event definition: the order of battle of 7 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Raon-l'Étape with a precision of 25 km, a point in the middle of the corps front; the passage names the end points of the front. Location approximate: a town point in the middle of the front. Location support: CMH names the canal and Saulcy-sur-Meurthe. Commander: General Thumm. Opponents: US XV Corps and VI Corps.

unit_name: LXIV Corps (LXIV Reserve Corps until 5 August 1944)
current_activity: LXIV Corps holds the area between Sélestat and Barr with remnants of the 708th VG and 716th Divisions
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 25 p. 453: "Thumm's battered LXIV Corps held the area between Selestat and Barr". Event definition: the situation of 26 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Sélestat with a precision of 10 km, one of the two towns that bound the area. Location approximate: a town point at the end of the sector. Location support: CMH names Selestat and Barr. Commander: General Thumm. Opponents: US VI Corps (103d and 3d Infantry Divisions).
